checks.name: Structure and frontmatter
checks.detail: quick_validate.py: valid name, description and layout. skill_standard_report.py: 0 warnings.

checks.name: Prompt lint and routing
checks.detail: lint_cruft.py --routing: 0 high, 0 medium, 0 low findings. Blind routing test: 16 of 16 requests routed as expected against adjacent skills.

checks.name: Executable code
checks.detail: No scripts, binaries or install hooks. Markdown instructions and templates only.

checks.name: Secrets and private data
checks.detail: No tokens, keys, private paths or personal data. Examples use placeholders (jane, acme, example.com).

checks.name: Network and data exfiltration
checks.detail: Reads the project files the user points to and writes Markdown files under marketing/ in the user's project. No network access. No links besides the skill's own references.

checks.name: Instruction safety
checks.detail: No instruction overrides or hidden characters. Requires real numbers with source and date, user approval before files are marked final, and never publishes on the user's behalf.
